executive_summary: Episode 5 presents a detailed timeline of Erika Kirk from 1988-2010, focusing on her educational institutions (Tesseract, St. Ursula Villa, Walnut Corner daycare), her mother Lori Frantzve's business entities (E3 Tech, Virtual Registration International, Intellment International, Intel of Arizona LLC), and military/government connections. Key artifacts include the Tesseract charter school documents, corporate filings, and references to Operation Enduring Freedom. The episode introduces multiple investigation targets including the missing years 1999-2002, Lori's government contracts, and Tyler Bowyer's 2010 Romania trip.

claims.label: Erika attended Walnut Corner Daycare in 1991
claims.claim: Erika Kirk attended Walnut Corner Daycare in Cincinnati, Ohio in 1991, photo shows her near third birthday.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify daycare enrollment records and Child Care Visions corporate ownership.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika will attend a private daycare that's at the Walnut Corner in Cincinnati, Ohio.

claims.label: Erika attended Tesseract School 1995-1998
claims.claim: Erika Kirk attended Tesseract School in Paradise Valley from 1995 to 1998.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain enrollment records from Tesseract for 1995-1998 school years.
claims.transcript_snippet: 1995, Erika is attending the Tesseract school down in Paradise Valley.

claims.label: Kent and Lori filed for divorce in 1998
claims.claim: Kent and Lori Frantzve filed for divorce in Cincinnati in 1998 while Erika was in third grade at Tesseract.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain divorce filing documents from Hamilton County, Ohio courts.
claims.transcript_snippet: And this is when Lori and Kent will file for a divorce in Cincinnati.

claims.label: Lori formed multiple corporations 1999-2003
claims.claim: Lori Frantzve formed Virtual Registration International (Dec 1999), Intellment International (Dec 1999), and Intel of Arizona LLC (Jan 2003).
claims.investigative_direction: Verify corporate filings through Arizona and Delaware state records.
claims.transcript_snippet: December 1st, 1999, she forms Virtual Registration International Incorporated.

claims.label: Lori formed Luminarius LLC with Deborah Himil in 2010
claims.claim: Jerry Frantzve created Luminarius LLC with her daughter Deborah Himil in January 2010.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Luminarius LLC filing documents from Arizona corporation commission.
claims.transcript_snippet: Jerry Frantzve creates an LLC called Luminarius with her daughter, the one that she had when she was 14, Deborah Himil.

claims.label: E3 Tech participated in Operation Enduring Freedom
claims.claim: E3 Tech, Lori's company, participated in Operation Enduring Freedom according to its website.

claims.transcript_snippet: Lori is going to receive a lot of money from the Army National Guard. IMAT Laboratories... is going to have to disclose that they gave $2.4 million to IMAT laboratories.

claims.transcript_snippet: this crucial year where Erika is missing, her mother is going to wind up having received $2.4 million.

claims.transcript_snippet: Lori Frantzve is going to establish Everyday Heroes Like You in April. In her filing, she will claim that it is a faithbased organization that is raising funds and developing programs for vulnerable children.

claims.transcript_snippet: Remember I told you he lost his legal license in uh 2009.

claims.label: Rick engaged in mortgage fraud and stock transfer scheme
claims.claim: Rick Erpenbeck was investigated for failing to disclose existing mortgages when performing title searches, and for managing an LLC used to transfer stock without consideration.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Kentucky bar investigation documents and court records.
claims.transcript_snippet: Reason number one is because while employed by the Bank of Corbin to perform title searches on certain properties, Rick didn't inform the bank that other mortgages already existed on those properties.

claims.claim: Charlie Kirk met Erika at an airport in Israel; her mother Lori told her to go up to him.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify travel records and witnesses to this meeting.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie was at the airport in Israel. You saw him. Your mom said go up to him. She's a pusher, right?
claims.uncertainty_note: Claim based on Erika's account; no independent verification presented
